_about: CRL metadata-annotation registry — the canonical tag vocabulary, value shapes, cardinality, and lifecycle for `@tag` annotations carried on `- meta is `@tag: <body>`.` lines. Consumed by the (future) Validator; human companion is metadata-model.md in this folder.
statusNote: Core vocabulary stable (two design-review rounds). v0.2.0 adds the review-flag tags per KE #203 (additive; two further design-review rounds — disc 220). The Validator that enforces these rules is not yet implemented (see README — validateCRL is a placeholder). Ref schemes (kg:/reef:) are illustrative. Renames go through `aliases`; a rename should add the old id to the new tag's `aliases` so existing `.crl` flags don't orphan.

carrier.terminator: the `.` goes AFTER the closing backtick: - meta is `...`.
carrier.scopeNote: REALITY: the `meta` carrier parses ONLY on `concept` (metaLine* in conceptBody). `plannedScope` (decision + library) is the KE #203 future carrier — a grammar change (Todo 2). Until it lands, decision/library meta lines are ParserErrors; `plannedScope` documents intent, `scope` documents what actually parses.
carrier.backCompat: A meta line with no leading @tag is a legitimate untyped note and passes validation.

families.A-external-ref: Scored hints to an external store. Candidates are extraction-derived (replace-by-run); confirmed are durable.

ExternalReference.note: Shared shape for the two external-ref tags. KG (Concept Graph) and REEF are DISTINCT stores serving different purposes; both hold scored hints.
ExternalReference.rendering: <display label>; ref <ref>; confidence <0..1>; rank <int>; status <enum>; by <author>

system.source: derived from the tag (@kg-concept -> kg [the Concept Graph, hint for the decision], @reef-reference -> reef [the great REEF, a hint])

ref.note: identifier within the Concept Graph (kg) or REEF (reef)

rank.note: 1-based; 1 = best-ranked candidate. Explicit; NOT inferred from line order.

Origin.rendering: trailing `; by <author>; run <id>; at <iso-timestamp>; source <ref>#<hash>; span <range>; quote <text>`

by.note: omitted = implicit current author of the edit

span.note: source span/range — more actionable than a whole-doc hash

tags.notes: Stable concept identifier. Durable metadata should key on @id so a concept rename does not orphan its tags. Rename/split/merge handling is a known v1 gap.
Author's gloss of the object. Distinct from `evidence` (verbatim source quote).

emit.condition: only unresolved (status open|deferred) emits; emitter MUST sanitize comment delimiters (*/)

tags.notes: Informaticist -> KE collaboration note; must survive to generated CQL.

emit.condition: emit as CQL block comment; emitter MUST sanitize */

tags.notes: Captures THE LOGIC — the case features / decision points (what the logic tests). Pairs with controlled-natural-language (which captures the flow). Emitted as a CQL block comment so the logic statement reaches downstream CQL readers.
Captures THE LOGIC FLOW — the order and sequencing in which the logic is applied (how). Pairs with logic-expression-text (which captures the case features / decision points).

emit.condition: emit as CQL block comment; emitter MUST sanitize */

tags.notes: CNL for logic CRL cannot express yet (missing CQL operators/valueTypes). Dual consumer: a local KE note AND CRL-roadmap telemetry.

emit.condition: emit as CQL block comment; emitter MUST sanitize */

tags.notes: Business logic intentionally deferred (not yet implemented in CRL/CQL). Lands in a CQL block comment so the deferral is visible to downstream CQL readers. Distinct from clinical-logic-deferred (deferred clinical decision logic).

emit.condition: emit as CQL block comment; emitter MUST sanitize */

tags.notes: Clinical decision logic intentionally deferred (not yet implemented in CRL/CQL). Lands in a CQL block comment so the deferral is visible to downstream CQL readers. Distinct from business-logic-deferred.

emit.condition: emit the BODY as a plain CQL block-comment line with NO `@cql-comment:` tag prefix (raw passthrough); emitter MUST sanitize */

tags.notes: Verbatim author comment to carry into the generated CQL. Unlike the other emit.cql tags, the `@cql-comment:` prefix is stripped — only the body text appears in the emitted CQL comment.

tags.lifecycleNote: status=candidate entries replaced on re-extraction; status=confirmed entries are durable
tags.notes: Scored HINT FOR THE DECISION — a reference to a node in the Concept Graph ('KG' = Concept Graph). ref scheme `kg:` illustrative.

tags.lifecycleNote: status=candidate entries replaced on re-extraction; status=confirmed entries are durable
tags.notes: Scored HINT for REEF ('the great reef') — the likely concept in REEF, the downstream artifact repo the CRL->CQL/FHIR skill + compiler consume. A hint, not an authoritative mapping. ref scheme `reef:` illustrative.
Semantic parse of the SOURCE narrative (meaning representation). Extraction exhaust.

status.note: no `deferred` for review flags — a flag is open (emit+warn+ship-gate) or resolved (durable, no emit, no gate)

assumption.note: the provisional reading taken pending the ruling

key.note: stable re-detect key (agent-supplied: @id + a normalized source-span/hash). Matches a `resolved` tombstone to suppress re-add on a later extraction run.

tags.lifecycleNote: status open -> resolved; `resolved` is a DURABLE tombstone (NOT deleted) whose body carries the ruling. Grep `status open` for the open worklist.

plannedEmit.condition: only status=open emits — pre-ship KE-workflow visibility; the ship-gate resolves all open flags before ship, so the shipped artifact is clean. Status-aware emit is Todo 4 (#203).

tags.notes: REVIEW FLAG. An EXTERNAL-stakeholder ambiguity resolved provisionally, pending a customer/Burton ruling. Resolve when the ruling arrives (record it in the `resolved` body). Distinct from @open-fork (INTERNAL modeling alternatives).

key.note: stable re-detect key (see @customer-confirmable) — critical here: the SOURCE contradiction persists across runs, so the key lets a `resolved` tombstone suppress a re-extraction re-add.

tags.lifecycleNote: status open -> resolved (durable tombstone carrying the grounding/interpretation).
tags.notes: REVIEW FLAG (stop-and-flag). The SOURCE contradicts ITSELF (e.g. a preamble 'BMI >= 40' vs an operative 'greater than 40'). A source-vs-source contradiction — distinct from @fidelity-defect (encoding != source). Resolve by grounding the encoding in a ruling/interpretation (recorded in the `resolved` body).

alternatives.note: the un-taken modeling alternatives still open

tags.lifecycleNote: status open -> resolved (durable tombstone recording the adjudication).
tags.notes: REVIEW FLAG. A genuine INTERNAL modeling fork — encoded one way (`; chosen <branch>`) but not settled; the alternatives (`; alternatives <...>`) remain open. Distinct from @customer-confirmable (needs an EXTERNAL ruling). Resolve when the fork is adjudicated.

direction.note: over-reach = the encoding ADDED logic the source doesn't support; criterion-drop = the encoding OMITTED a source-required criterion

tags.notes: REVIEW FLAG. A known encoding != source defect to fix. ONE umbrella + a `; direction` discriminator (collapses the KE's @over-reach-to-fix / @criterion-drop-to-fix per the umbrella-pattern discipline; those names are `aliases`). Resolve by correcting the encoding.

ref.note: the tracker issue id (e.g. #203) — 'filed' is meaningless without it; a gap-filed WITHOUT a ref is an error

tags.lifecycleNote: DELETE when the CRL no longer depends on the gap. Delete-on-fix is DELIBERATE here (unlike the review flags): the durable record lives in the FILED ISSUE, not inline.

plannedEmit.condition: emit as a CQL block comment — a visible tracked gap, like @business-logic-deferred. Todo 4.

tags.notes: A durable POINTER to a filed gap/issue — NOT a review flag (no `reviewFlag`, no `warnWhileOpen`, no `status`): a filed gap is managed work that ships fine (like `// TODO(#123)`). Requires `; ref <issue>`. Covers the KE's @stage-boundary case when the gap is FILED; the un-filed 'stage/language can't express this' cases REUSE @crl-future-expression (language limit) / @business-logic-deferred / @clinical-logic-deferred (deferred logic).

validatorRules: value-shape mismatch (e.g. @kg-concept missing ref; confidence outside [0,1]; rank < 1) -> error
cardinality violation (e.g. two @description on one concept) -> error
malformed-tag lint: a meta line starting '@' but not matching ^@[a-z][a-z0-9-]*: -> warning (probable malformed tag — catches silent demotion to an untyped note)
a meta line NOT starting '@' -> legitimate untyped note (back-compat), no diagnostic
re-run staleness: warn if two distinct run ids' family-C / candidate-ref exhaust coexist on one concept
family-C tags and candidate (status=candidate) external refs MUST carry `run` -> error if omitted (otherwise the re-run replace match key is undefined)

review flag (`reviewFlag:true`) with status=open (or status absent -> defaults open) -> WARNING (open review flag — resolve before ship). Ship-blocking is a `shipPolicy` escalation (Todo 3); the base diagnostic is a warning per KE #203.

review-flag RE-ADD GUARD: an extractor MUST NOT emit a review flag whose `key` matches an existing status=resolved tombstone on the same target (the source property persists, but the human resolution stands). A genuinely-new instance (different `key` / source-span) MAY be added.
@gap-filed without a `ref` -> error (a filed gap needs its issue id)
review flags use status open|resolved ONLY -> a review flag with status=deferred is an error (deferred/tracked work is @gap-filed or @business-logic-deferred, not a review flag)
reRunReplaceRule: On re-extraction, the producer replaces the prior run's family-C tags (semantic-parse-text) and candidate (status=candidate) external refs for a concept, matched by by/run. Confirmed refs and family-B durable tags (id, description, ke-feedback, logic-expression-text, controlled-natural-language, crl-future-expression, business-logic-deferred, clinical-logic-deferred, cql-comment, customer-confirmable, internal-inconsistency, open-fork, fidelity-defect, gap-filed) are never auto-replaced. Refs with status=rejected or status=superseded are durable historical records (preserved across re-runs so negative review work isn't lost). REVIEW-FLAG RE-ADD GUARD (`reviewFlag:true`): a resolved review-flag tombstone is durable; on re-extraction the producer MUST NOT re-add a review flag whose `key` matches an existing status=resolved tombstone on the same target — matched by (tag id + attachment `@id` + `key`, where `key` is a normalized source-span/hash). Prevents a persistent source contradiction from re-opening a flag the human already resolved.
